newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was inactive in the panhandle area late Monday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested at the close.

Feedlots reported light to moderate inquiry from buyers. 29,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,900 head formulated and 900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Confirmed: None Week Ago: None Year Ago: 200
Wk to date: 29,300 Week Ago: 4,500 Year Ago: 15,000
